clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 6ª colonna, nella 2ª riga e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 6th column, in the 2nd row and west of Vito.

clues.it: Irene era nella 10ª colonna e nella 3ª riga, ma non era accanto a un oblò.
clues.en: Irene was in the 10th column and in the 3rd row, but was not beside a porthole.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 4ª riga, accanto a una consolle e a ovest di Olga.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 4th row, beside a console and west of Olga.

clues.it: Giada era nella 7ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e accanto a una vasca idroponica.
clues.en: Giada was in the 7th column, in the 5th row and beside a hydroponic tank.

clues.it: Anna era nella 6ª riga e a ovest di Olga.
clues.en: Anna was in the 6th row and west of Olga.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 8ª colonna e nella 7ª riga, ma non era accanto a una poltrona.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 8th column and in the 7th row, but was not beside a flight seat.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a un serbatoio e a ovest di Irene.
clues.en: Dario was beside a fuel tank and west of Irene.

clues.it: Elena era su un fascio di cavi, a ovest di Giada e da sola sul Ponte di Comando.
clues.en: Elena was on a cable bundle, west of Giada and alone on the Command Deck.

clues.it: Olga era accanto a un fascio di cavi e in una stanza diversa da Sergio.
clues.en: Olga was beside a cable bundle and in a different room from Sergio.

clues.it: Vito era nella 11ª riga, ma non era accanto a un reattore.
clues.en: Vito was in the 11th row, but was not beside a reactor.

clues.it: Luca era in una stanza diversa da Elena e in Laboratorio.
clues.en: Luca was in a different room from Elena and in the Lab.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
